feature: Git access layer and context builder
problem: The agent needs to access real git diffs, messages, and file history for investigation. A clone script and GitContextProvider abstract git CLI access. CommitContextBuilder assembles the full investigation context bundle from git + CSV features + precomputed author stats.
proposed_solution: Shell script for cloning Camel/Hadoop repos. GitContextProvider wrapping git CLI. CommitContextBuilder composing context bundles. AuthorStatsIndex precomputed from train split.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: scripts/clone_apache_repos.sh exists, is executable, clones Camel and Hadoop into data/repos/
AC-2: Clone script is idempotent (skip if repo already exists), supports configurable target dir
AC-3: src/commit_investigator/git_context.py exists with GitContextProvider class
AC-4: GitContextProvider.get_diff(commit_id) returns unified diff string for a commit
AC-6: GitContextProvider.get_touched_files(commit_id) returns list of file paths modified by commit
AC-7: GitContextProvider.get_file_history(path, n=3) returns last n commits touching that file
AC-8: GitContextProvider handles missing/invalid commit IDs gracefully (returns None or raises specific error, not subprocess crash)

AC-10: CommitContextBuilder.build(commit_id, project, csv_row) returns a structured context bundle dataclass/dict containing: diff, message, touched_files, csv_features, file_history for touched files, author_stats
AC-11: AuthorStatsIndex class exists (in context_builder.py or separate module) that precomputes per-author stats from train CSV (commit count, buggy rate, avg metrics)
AC-12: AuthorStatsIndex is built from train split only (no test data leakage)
AC-13: All new modules importable: python -c 'from commit_investigator.git_context import GitContextProvider; from commit_investigator.context_builder import CommitContextBuilder'
edge_cases: EC-1: GitContextProvider works with repos that are not yet cloned — raises clear error pointing to clone script
EC-2: get_file_history on a file that was deleted in a later commit still returns historical commits
EC-3: CommitContextBuilder handles commits with no CSV row gracefully (partial context with available fields)
verification_method: Evaluator verifies: script exists and is executable, module imports work, GitContextProvider methods have correct signatures, CommitContextBuilder produces expected structure. Full integration test requires cloned repos (skip if absent).
